decisions.what: Created TASTE.md as the group's medium-agnostic taste constitution and wired it into all three AI entry points (README, AI_PLAYBOOK, CLAUDE.md)
decisions.why: Repo taught AI operations+correctness well but taste was undiscoverable (craft docs were orphans in references/, never linked from the front door). Brainstormed the spine with the founder: one line 'precision you feel but cant see'; feeling = multi-billion-dollar production value as craft not bling; north star = blend of blockbuster (Inception/King: alive, atmospheric, grounded) + keynote (Apple-level: clean, every element intentional); three principles from King (grounded specificity) / Inception (nothing wasted, load-bearing) / South Park (smarter than it looks, applies to visuals AND substance); two banned enemies = hollow polish and cheap-looking; meta-rule = coherence (never leak between brands/media); enforcement = aspirational bar by default, hard block only for unforgivable (ai-tell copy, brand leak, placeholder, emoji-as-icon). TASTE.md sits above CSS so it survives into future media (3D printing). Medium playbooks (MOTION-CRAFT, VISUAL-LOCK, ai-tell-corpus) are children that translate the constitution.

decisions.what: Built the aitell anti-AI-tell production pipeline: orchestrator (tools/aitell-pipeline.cjs) + new stylometry module (tools/ai-stylometry.cjs) + PRODUCTION-PIPELINE.md, wired into bin/ai.cjs (aitell + taste cmds) and npm scripts
decisions.why: Unified the 4 separate anti-AI-tell tools behind one command that inspects every production step in 3 cheapest-first stages: (1) deterministic corpus = the ONLY blocking stage (ai-tell-lint for text, ai-sheen-lint for image prompts), (2) stylometry = advisory multi-signal score 0-100 (sentence/paragraph uniformity, n-gram repetition, connective+hedge density, list rigidity, opening repetition; language-aware en vs cjk), (3) LLM naturalness judge = advisory opt-in via --judge. Stylometry is advisory-only by design because perplexity/burstiness-style metrics false-positive on strong + non-native writing (would punish our zh/ja/th copy). Verified discrimination: AI-ish text scored 63-85/100, natural human text 0/100, TASTE.md 7/100 (proves it's human-voiced). Fixed a real bug: stylometry must strip <style>/<script>/<svg> CONTENTS for HTML or inline CSS poisons the n-gram signal. Exit code only changes on Stage 1 block; advisory stages never coerce. Both new docs added to ai-tell EXEMPT_FILES (they quote bans to teach) and written with zero em-dashes.

Research finding (Pangram 2025 + stylometry papers): perplexity & burstiness are NOT reliable AI-detection gates — they false-positive on strong human writing (low-perplexity classics) and systematically bias against non-native/ESL writers (lower perplexity by nature), which is dangerous for our ZH/JA/TH copy. Many models (Gemini/Claude) don't expose token probs anyway. State of the art = (1) multi-signal feature stylometry (F1 0.94 vs perplexity-alone) not any single metric, (2) deep-learning/LLM judge trained on human-vs-AI pairs with ACTIVE LEARNING (self-improves from flagged examples — our mycelium loop already fits this), (3) for REDUCTION: intentional imperfection + specific voice + concrete detail beats synonym-swapping (which degrades quality). Design rule: use statistical signals as ADVISORY warnings only, never as the hard block; the block stays on deterministic corpus patterns + the LLM judge.
Layout linter emoji detection must exclude monochrome dingbat UI glyphs (close-glyph U+2715, check U+2713, etc); only colour emoji are the AI-build tell. Require VS16 (U+FE0F) for BMP-range symbols.
